The test `test_write_subset_columns` checks whether the `to_excel` method correctly writes a DataFrame to an Excel file when only a subset of columns is specified. However, the test failure indicates that this is not the case. Following the execution path, we find that the `to_excel` method in pandas' DataFrame class does not handle the case where only a subset of columns is written.

Looking at the code snippet for the `to_excel` method, we can see that it first checks if the input DataFrame is an ABCDataFrame instance, and if so, uses its values directly. However, this check does not cover the case where a subset of columns is written.

Consequently, when only a subset of columns is specified in the test (in this case, `columns=["A", "B"]`), the incorrect behavior occurs because the `to_excel` method writes all columns of the original DataFrame, including column "C", which is not included in the subset. This leads to the error demonstrated by the test.
